prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection area in Baytown, Texas, I found two passenger vehicles stopped at the curb lane with visible contact damage along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and the left front side of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 stated that while changing lanes to the left, the side of Driver 2's vehicle came into contact with their own vehicle. Driver 2 confirmed the lane change and the sideswipe and did not dispute the sequence. Two independent witnesses on the scene gave statements consistent with both drivers, and each said they saw the vehicles make contact as described. Photographs taken at the scene match the reported point of impact and the pattern of the damage. Passenger, who was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, was present at the time of the collision and confirmed this to me. Driver 1 reported a knee injury from striking the dashboard area and was assessed at the scene. Based on the position of the vehicles and the nature of the contact, the damage observed is generally consistent with the reported impact. I found no indication of prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 identified themselves as a household member of the policyholder.
